in_arabic.name: Jumlanah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Jumlanah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Arabic, Jumlanah means 'she who gathers' or 'collector'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'jaml' which means 'to gather' or 'collect'. In Islamic tradition, Jumlanah represents the power and grace of Allah in bringing people and things together.
